Let
\[
f(z)=zg(z).
\]
By Schwarz lemma, \(g:\mathbb D\to\mathbb D\) is holomorphic, and the two interpolation conditions give
\[
g\!\left(\frac12\right)=g\!\left(-\frac12\right)=\frac23.
\]
Also
\[
f''(0)=2g'(0),
\]
so it remains to maximize \(|g'(0)|\).

Set
\[
h(z)=\frac{g(z)-\frac23}{1-\frac23 g(z)}.
\]
Then \(h:\mathbb D\to\mathbb D\) and
\[
h\!\left(\frac12\right)=h\!\left(-\frac12\right)=0.
\]
Thus
\[
h(z)=B(z)k(z),
\]
where \(k:\mathbb D\to\mathbb D\) and
\[
B(z)=\frac{z-\frac12}{1-\frac z2}\cdot \frac{z+\frac12}{1+\frac z2}
=\frac{z^2-\frac14}{1-\frac{z^2}{4}}.
\]
Since \(B(0)=-\frac14\) and \(B'(0)=0\), writing \(c=k(0)\), we have
\[
h(0)=-\frac c4,\qquad h'(0)=-\frac{k'(0)}4.
\]
By Schwarz-Pick,
\[
|k'(0)|\le 1-|c|^2.
\]

Now
\[
g(z)=\frac{\frac23+h(z)}{1+\frac23 h(z)},
\]
so
\[
g'(0)=\frac{1-\frac49}{\left(1+\frac23 h(0)\right)^2}h'(0).
\]
Therefore
\[
|g'(0)|
\le
\frac{5}{9}\cdot \frac{1-|c|^2}{4\left|1-\frac c6\right|^2}
=
\frac{5}{36}\cdot \frac{1-|c|^2}{\left|1-\frac c6\right|^2}.
\]
For fixed \(r=|c|\), the denominator is minimized when \(c=r\ge 0\), so we maximize
\[
\frac{5}{36}\cdot \frac{1-r^2}{(1-r/6)^2},\qquad 0\le r\le 1.
\]
Its logarithmic derivative vanishes when
\[
-\frac{2r}{1-r^2}+\frac{1}{3(1-r/6)}=0,
\]
which gives \(r=\frac16\). Hence
\[
\max |g'(0)|
=
\frac{5}{36}\cdot \frac{1-\frac1{36}}{\left(1-\frac1{36}\right)^2}
=
\frac17.
\]
This is attained, for example, by taking
\[
k(z)=\frac{z+\frac16}{1+\frac z6}.
\]
Thus
\[
\sup |f''(0)|=2\sup |g'(0)|=\boxed{\frac27}.
\]
